user.title: Add an audio.cpp server
user.description: Enter the address of an audiocpp_server. TTS and STT engines are added afterwards from the server's entry.

data_description.url: Base URL of the server, for example http://192.168.1.10:8080.
data_description.api_key: audio.cpp has no authentication of its own. Only set this if a reverse proxy in front of it expects a Bearer token.

data_description.url: Base URL of the server, for example http://192.168.1.10:8080.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the current key, which is kept only while the host and port stay the same; for a different server, enter its key. audio.cpp has no authentication of its own; this is only for a reverse proxy that expects a Bearer token.

model.title: Choose a TTS model
model.description: Models the server runs in streaming mode can use the streaming endpoint.

settings.title: TTS engine settings
settings.description: Settings for {model}. Saving runs a short test synthesis, which can take a while if the server has to load the model first.

data_description.languages: Languages this engine offers to Home Assistant. The first is the default. audio.cpp does not report what a model speaks, so pick what your model and voice actually support.
data_description.voice: A voice id or a voice preset from the server config. Leave empty to use the model's default_voice_preset.
data_description.streaming: Receive audio as it is generated (SSE PCM). Only offered for models the server runs with mode streaming.
data_description.split_sentences: Start speaking after the first sentence instead of waiting for the whole reply. Turn off if the model sounds better with the full text.
data_description.speed: Speech rate multiplier. Only shown for models with speed control, within the range the model declares. Servers before audio.cpp v0.9.1 do not say, so it is always shown there and the test synthesis tells you if the model rejects it.
data_description.extra_options: Extra fields merged into every speech request, for example seed, max_tokens or an options object with model options. model, input and the format fields are set by the integration. Keys the model does not declare are flagged before the test synthesis.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The audio.cpp server is not loaded. Check that it is reachable, then try again.

error.no_models: The server has no ASR models configured. You can still type a model id.

model.title: Choose an ASR model
model.description: Models the server runs in streaming mode can transcribe while you speak.

data_description.languages: Languages this engine offers to Home Assistant.
data_description.streaming: Send audio while it is captured (/v1/audio/transcriptions/live), so the model decodes as you speak. Off uploads the whole recording when you stop. Only offered for models the server runs with mode streaming.
data_description.language_hint: Whether to pass the conversation language to the model. Some models take none and reject the field.
data_description.prompt: Optional context such as names or hotwords, for models that support it.

engine_options.title: TTS engine {engine} has settings {model} does not accept
engine_options.description:
The audio.cpp server's description of {model} does not match the settings of the TTS engine {engine}: {problems}.

This often follows a server upgrade that renamed an option. Reconfigure the engine from the audio.cpp server's entry to fix it. If the model does take these settings, ignore this issue.
